subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, consent, and config contract should be accepted?
rationale: The remaining request changes Google Chat data visibility, OAuth/event-subscription credentials, and operator consent; source review can prove the gap but cannot choose the security boundary.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Limit Google Chat To Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin service-account and mention-triggered, while resolving thread reliability separately.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold this until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, token, event-subscription, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combination of recent Google Chat history and product/security routing relevance for the OAuth/events boundary.
